targets.name: Local\Temp
targets.description: User temporary files (%LOCALAPPDATA%\Temp). Safe to clean routinely.

targets.name: D:\Temp
targets.description: Temporary folder on D: drive if present.

targets.name: npm cache
targets.description: npm package cache. Only the cache directory, not node_modules or global packages.

targets.name: uv cache
targets.description: uv (Python package manager) cache. CAUTION until exact cache root is confirmed.

targets.name: pip cache
targets.description: pip package cache. Safe to clean.

targets.name: Chrome cache
targets.description: Chrome browser cache (Cache, Code Cache, GPUCache only). Cookies, history, passwords are NOT touched.

targets.name: Edge cache
targets.description: Edge browser cache (Cache, Code Cache, GPUCache only). Cookies, history, passwords are NOT touched.

targets.name: DirectX shader cache
targets.description: Direct3D shader cache (D3DSCache) and NVIDIA DXCache/GLCache. Safe; rebuilt on next run.

targets.name: Crash dumps
targets.description: Application crash dumps (WER, Minidump, LiveKernelReports, CrashDumps). Safe if not debugging.
